description: Find work orders on this account, newest first: production work orders a manufacturing order generated and workshop work orders alike. Filter by status (open, waitingApproval, readyForProduction, started, onHold, waitingCompletion, completed, canceled), type (production, workshop, info), manufacturingOrderId, or text in the number, customer or description. Each row lists the status changes transition_work_order can make. Up to 100 per page. Operator credentials only.
